known.fact: Owner of Hvidsten Kro, leader of the receiver group that collects the Halifax drops, including the 80 kg for Langå on 15 Nov.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Arrested at dawn 11 Mar 1944 with his son Niels and son-in-law Peder Sørensen; all three shot at Ryvangen in June.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
